head_anchor: C155 small_step12 cyclic_rate_1e4 before/after; all3x2x36 coefficients
path: P(alpha)=P0+alpha*(P1-P0), left-associated e=(w0*P[0]+w1*P[1])+w2*P[2], u=V@(raw-prepared), theta=raw+V.T@(e[0]*u+e[1]*roll(u,+1)). All constants exact FP64 casts, no final FP32 cast in differentiable path.
rounding_boundary: This continuous precommit FP64 path is NOT the exact FP32-commit function or the C158 rounded-endpoint chord. Both differences and coefficient alpha1 rounding are retained. No straight-through derivative is used or certified for the FP32 cast.
routing: Original archived prewrite convex weights stay fixed; no route recomputation, new features or routing selection.

references.current_FP64: First current-run FP64 all-zero LoRA-B chart baseline response; NOT the nonzero chord alpha0 output.
references.archived_FP64: Unchanged original C155 FP64 response reference
references.archived_FP32: Unchanged original C155 cached FP32 response reference

reference_rule: Fixed before model loading: take first current FP64 zero-chart forward mean at the original six response IDs. Repeat once, save both full logits, freeze all three references and hashes before focus-state probes. No measured focus state is used to choose or recenter a reference.
cross_run: All FP32/FP64 baseline and four endpoint differences from original C155 are reported, including the historical 2e-9 comparison. These differences do not gate this separate same-run derivative experiment. They do not satisfy or replace C157 replay, writer acceptance or LC2 gates.
AD: Six response-coordinate scalar-alpha derivatives and three scalar loss reverse calls per state. Each loss reverse call jointly returns gradients with respect to alpha, effective2xrank controls and complete3x2xrank coefficients. All other tensors frozen. No model-parameter gradients or parameter Jacobian.
chain: Independently form w*g_effective, its contraction with deltaP, and compare to direct coefficient gradient and alpha AD; retain signed residuals without a derivative-agreement pass threshold. Independent NumPy precommit construction and exact original FP32 map are checked before model.
response_loss: relu(max(abs(absolute_response-fixed_reference))/.0018-1)^2, separately for each of three references. No KL/read/full84 objective or FP64 qualification.
scope: Training-only two-state same-run FP64 precommit coefficient-chain diagnostic. Original C155-C158 decisions retained. No derivative certification for discrete FP32 commit, accuracy/error/curvature bound, optimizer causality, feasibility or generalisation. No training, fitting, head/route/step selection, deployment, preparation, fresh confirmation, excluded-input testing or full84 FP64 qualification.
